description: This file defines a singleton class 'CLIInstallPrompter' responsible for prompting the user to install the CLI component of the application. It manages user prompts, installation routines, and opens settings, with internal methods to determine if prompting is necessary. It also includes an actor 'StatusBox' for managing status messages asynchronously.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages prompting the user to install the CLI when appropriate, and handles associated actions like installing the CLI and opening settings.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: An actor class used internally within 'CLIInstallPrompter' to manage status messages asynchronously during CLI installation.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether to prompt the user for CLI installation and displays an alert with options if needed.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether the user should be prompted, based on app state and prior prompts.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous installation process of the CLI, showing status updates.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the application settings window and navigates to the specified tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the app's version string from the bundle info dictionary.
